source_text.ISS-0917:
id: ISS-0917
title: "Catalog SERVICE_TASK cannot execute: ServiceTaskDispatcher.catalog_lookup_stub/2 is an unconditional {:error,:not_registered}; POST /tasks/:id/complete returns 500 when the next node is a catalog-only SERVICE_TASK"
discovered_by: RELEASE-VALIDATOR
discovered_in_run: WF02-REQ432-20260930 (filed by ORCH)
discovered_at: "2026-09-30T20:50:51Z"
severity: MAJOR
owner: "ELIXIR-DEV"
description: >
  Found by WF02-REQ432-20260930 (REQ-432 live pipeline run,
  test/reports/report-20260930-WF02-REQ432-20260930.yaml; step-02b-rework1-frontend-
  dev.json). A process whose SERVICE_TASK references a service_id (catalog_entry pin) cannot
  ever execute: Letflow.Engine.ServiceTaskDispatcher.catalog_lookup_stub/2
  (lib/letflow/engine/service_task_dispatcher.ex ~411-416) returns {:error,:not_registered}
  unconditionally, so activation renders an empty URL. Measured live: completing the
  preceding human task hops synchronously into the SERVICE_TASK, the engine persists only
  EXECUTION_ERROR (affected node n3, error_type service_task_url_rendered_empty, no
  TASK_COMPLETED for the completed task) and POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete answers HTTP
  500 (probably needs a non-500 mapping for {:instance_execution_error,_,_} in
  lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex). Independent of service retirement. Consequence: scenario
  platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change EO-001/EO-004 'the in-flight step completes
  without error' cannot be met on success; REQ-432's pipeline spec accepts the measured
  outcome (B) as a documented limitation. Needed: resolve service_id through the instance's
  PINNED service_catalog version (Letflow.Engine.PinResolver / ServiceCatalog lookup) in the
  dispatcher, then tighten the REQ-432 spec step 03 to require success. SCOPE GAP already
  noted in design docs lib/letflow/design/req373-service-catalog-version-lifecycle.md and
  lib/letflow/design/req432-rebind-pins-publish-retire-ui.md (M5). Owner ELIXIR-DEV (via
  CODE-DESIGNER). Severity MAJOR.
  NOTE (added by ORCH at close-out of the cancelled duplicate run WF02-REQ432-20260930): the
  REQ-432 implementation that actually landed on main is PR #2055 (5d7ca7bf), not this run's
  branch. Its spec (web/tests/e2e/pipelines/platform-instance-pin-survives-catalog-change
  .pipeline.e2e.spec.ts, header 'Scope note (deliberately not exercised): SERVICE_TASK dispatch')
  never drives a token onto the SERVICE_TASK node, so on main the scenario's 'the in-flight step
  completes without error' (EO-001/EO-004 step 3) is unverified; the evidence of this stub's effect
  is the duplicate run's live finding (archived on remote branch feature/WF02-REQ432-20260930,
  handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-02b-rework1-frontend-dev.json and step-05-release-validator.json).
source_reports:
  - handoffs/WF02-REQ432-20260930/step-05-release-validator.json
  - test/reports/report-20260930-WF02-REQ432-20260930.yaml
affected_files:

  - lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex
queue_ref: Q-907  # queue allocated issue_ref ISS-0907, which collides with an existing local file; local filename kept as ISS-0917 (next free on origin/main) and GH-2057 retitled to match
github_ref: GH-2057
status: open

task.description: WF-03 Step 4: REGRESSION TESTS (ExUnit). Write the tests specified in design lib/letflow/design/iss0917-catalog-service-task-pinned-dispatch.md section 6.2 (T1-T11 incl. MANDATORY T8a, resolver matrix) and 6.3 (router R1-R3) plus any extra test the design's test-inventory (section 4.2) calls new. The implementation is already on this branch (committed). Read the design fully, ELIXIR-DEV handoff step-03-elixir-dev.json, REVIEWER/SECURITY handoffs for context. Follow docs/agents/instructions/ test conventions and docs/anti-patterns.md (255-char ExUnit name limit; async rules INV-1/ISS-0481; test tenant fixtures; the shared test DB is also used concurrently by other workers on this machine, so keep tests isolated and use the existing tenant fixture helpers). Use existing fixtures (engine_pin_resolver_catalog_test.exs graph_human_task_then_service_task, routers/tasks_test.exs insert_user!/insert_group!/insert_role! idiom). Tests must assert real behaviour (no tautologies). FAIL-FIRST PROOF (WF-03 Step 4, mandatory, state explicitly in the test spec/handoff): the pre-fix code is origin/main (merge-base) - create a throwaway worktree (`git worktree add` in a sibling directory such as C:/Users/tvolo/dev/ai-dala/letflow-wt-iss0917-prefix at origin/main) with a REAL COPY (robocopy /E, never junction/symlink - see core-directives.md) of deps and _build, copy ONLY your new test files into it, run them with MIX_ENV=test mix test <files>, record which tests FAIL pre-fix and why (they should fail on behaviour, not on missing module where avoidable; where the pre-fix failure is 'function does not exist' for the new resolver unit tests, the WF-03 'non-existence' rule applies: you MUST additionally MUTATE the shipped logic and record which tests fail per mutant). MUTANTS (traps the fix exists to handle) in a throwaway worktree of THIS branch, never in the main checkout: (m1) resolver falls back to the live current row when the pinned version is superseded; (m2) resolver ignores tenant visibility (returns other tenant's tenant-scoped entry); (m3) rebound pins (resolved_id nil) not handled by (service_id, version); (m4) required_auth != NONE not failing closed; (m5) catalog timeout wins instead of min(); (m6) completion-hop/timer-site not reconstructing pins (uses only create-time pins) or skipping the typed error; (m7) router 409 clause removed/reordered after the catch-all; (m8) dispatcher catalog arm bypasses transport/SSRF gate. Record per-mutant failing-test counts and names. After finishing, remove the worktrees (`git worktree remove --force`, verify the real deps/_build in the main checkout are untouched: `ls deps | wc -l` unchanged) and verify `git status --porcelain lib/` is empty in the main checkout. Then run YOUR new test files in the main checkout (scoped; no full suite - limited memory, shared DB) and quote pass counts; DB-contention failures from other workers' tenant schemas are environmental: re-run once and report honestly. Commit nothing; leave new/changed test files uncommitted in the main checkout (ORCH commits). Do NOT modify lib/ and do NOT touch web/ (a FRONTEND-DEV step handles the e2e spec in parallel on the same checkout, disjoint paths). Complete your handoff per HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md section 3 with artifacts_out and the fail-first + mutant tables in result.summary; next_action 'Route to TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR'.

Pre-fix failure of the new tests demonstrated on a throwaway worktree of origin/main
Mutants m1-m8 each recorded with failing tests
Worktrees removed; lib/ clean; real deps untouched

result.summary: Wrote ISS-0917 regression tests (all uncommitted; lib/ and web/ untouched). Files: test/letflow/engine_catalog_service_task_test.exs (T1-T11, 25 tests incl. mandatory T8a x3 and T8b x2), test/letflow/service_catalog_resolve_pinned_version_test.exs (resolver matrix, 15 tests), test/letflow/routers/tasks_test.exs (+R1-R3, 3 tests), spec test/specs/ISS-0917.md. Dispatcher tests of design 4.2 already exist from ELIXIR-DEV; verified via m8. POST-FIX (branch HEAD 07b288c9), MIX_ENV=test scoped: engine+resolver files 40/40 passed; routers/tasks_test.exs 75/75 passed; no 'default values for the optional arguments' warning in either log (helpers have no default args). mix letflow.check.test (full suite) NOT run per ORCH instruction (limited memory, shared DB). FAIL-FIRST (merge-base 0b1931d3, throwaway worktree, robocopy'd deps/_build): engine+resolver 36/40 fail (resolver: UndefinedFunctionError, non-existence rule -> mutants; engine: behavioural, completion hop returns {:instance_execution_error,:service_task_url_rendered_empty,{:node,"svc"}} as measured); the 4 passing are intentional regression guards. Router R1 fails pre-fix (500 vs 200), R2 fails pre-fix (500 vs 409), R3 guard passes both. MUTANTS (worktree of this branch, each reverted, lib clean after each): m1 live-row fallback 13/40 fail (T2,T4b,T4c,T8a x2,T8b x2 + 6 resolver); m2 no tenant visibility 4/40 (resolver other-tenant, scope-narrowed, get_for_tenant, T6); m3 rebound (service_id,version) disabled 5/40 (T4,T4b,T4c,T8a-unresolvable,T8b-unresolvable); m4 required_auth not failing closed 6/40 (T7 x4,T3b,T8a-auth); m5 catalog timeout wins 1/40 (T10 node-smaller); m6a completion hop without reconstructed pins 14/40; m6b timer/advance wrapper swallows typed error 3/40 (T8a x2,T8b); m7 router 409 clause after catch-all: R2 fails; m8 dispatcher catalog arm bypasses SSRF gate 2/46 in service_task_dispatcher_test.exs. All 9 killed. COVERAGE LIMITS: T11 failing branch (tenant_id_for_schema_name error at completion hop) is not reachable via public API (earlier hop steps use the same prefix); T11 is a lazy-evaluation control. Escalation-timer site not driven (shares the abort wrapper exercised by T8a/T8b, m6b). Environmental: m3 first run hit tenant_template duplicate-schema collision from a concurrent worker, re-run once clean. Cleanup: worktree removed and pruned, ls deps = 29 (unchanged), git status --porcelain lib/ empty. Note: design said router instance_status "active"; real response is "ACTIVE" (test asserts the real value).
